description: Rename a media folder, move it under another parent folder or to the top level, or both; pass at least one of name or parentId. The files and subfolders inside move with it and their URLs do not change. To move files between folders, move_media. Returns the updated folder.

id.description: The folder id to update (from list_media_folders)

parentId.description: New parent folder id to re-parent under; pass null to move it to the top level.

name: update_media_folder
title: Update media folder
